notional_positions.notes: Cash Flow Swap with J. Aron (Goldman Sachs affiliate), period Jul 1, 2005 to Jun 30, 2010. Net notional at Dec 31, 2008: 17,696,250 barrels crude oil; 371,621,250 gallons HO (= 8,848,125 bbl) + 371,621,250 gallons UG (= 8,848,125 bbl). Economically hedges 8,848,125 bbl heating oil crack spreads and 8,848,125 bbl unleaded gasoline crack spreads. CVR receives fixed price on HO/UG and pays fixed price on crude (net short crack spread). NOT designated as hedge under SFAS 133. Unrealized net gain $40.9M at Dec 31, 2008. Volume reported as crude oil barrels = 17,696 MBbls (crude leg of crack spread). No open NYMEX contracts at year-end.
